An empty decision map reports the evidence and returns UNRESOLVED. It does not invent a scientific threshold.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(MeasureQual)
source(system.file("examples", "toy-workflow.R", package = "MeasureQual"))
```

The complete synthetic declaration is installed at
`system.file("examples", "toy-workflow.R", package = "MeasureQual")`.
Its scientific choices are illustrative declarations, never engine defaults.

```{r}
t <- toy_spec()
s <- freeze_audit(t$spec)
check <- check_audit(s, t$data)
run <- run_audit(check, t$data)
record <- evidence_record(run, render = FALSE)
stopifnot(record$qualification$terminal_state == "UNRESOLVED")
record$interpretation_license$disposition
```
